notes: Passwords are now stored as salted PBKDF2-SHA-256 hashes (210,000 iterations, unique 16-byte salt per user) instead of a single unsalted SHA-256 digest; existing installs keep working because login verifies legacy hashes and transparently upgrades to the new format on success. The toolchain got real engineering guardrails: ESLint 10 with a flat config plus a TypeScript-typed preload/IPC bridge (tsc typechecks, the compiled bridge is byte-for-byte the same API), and a GitHub Actions CI workflow runs lint, build and the full smoke suite on every push. Money rounding to exact cents, validated JSON restore, backup retention and LAN token rotation are unchanged from 3.9.2.
